sourceSentences: [0] W timing is everything. Don't use it on cool down. You need to think carefully about when exactly you need to press it. If you use it, let's say when the enemy ADC is already staying out of your range, they will just see your W and wait out their duration.
[0] You have to not let her go in while your W is on cool down. So, play safe during that down time. If you have your W, you can try to fight her and you will win all.

[0] If enemy is below 40% HP, make sure to use it every time it costs 40.
[0] Your ultimate range also increases with levels. It is insanely large on level 16.
